mentions.name: T2 Model Skinner
mentions.description: A web-based model skinner for the game Tribes 2 that lets players create custom character skins. Its gallery of user-made skins has produced a new wave of community skins and even a Halloween skin contest.
mentions.source_excerpt: A few years ago, I made a model skinner for Tribes 2, a ~25 year old game that still has a loyal following: https://exogen.github.io/t2-model-skinner/ (if you check out the Gallery link there, you'll notice this app resulted in a whole new wave of skins, and even a Halloween skin contest)
